sentences.en: Welcome, everybody, to the lovely house and gardens of Rosewood, once the home of the famous writer, Sebastian George.
sentences.zh: 欢迎各位来到美丽的罗斯伍德庄园及其花园，这里曾是著名作家塞巴斯蒂安·乔治的故居。

sentences.en: He bought the house in 1902 although he had first seen it two years earlier.
sentences.zh: 他于1902年买下这栋房子，尽管早在两年前就已初次见到。

sentences.en: At that time the owners let it out to a tenant because George was too slow making up his mind to buy it.
sentences.zh: 当时房主将其租给了一位租客，因为乔治迟迟下不了决心购买。

sentences.en: When it came back on the market, there was n10 hesitation and he bought it immediately, for £9,300, even though the house had no bathroom, no running water upstairs, and no electricity.
sentences.zh: 当房子再度上市时，他毫不犹豫，立即以9300英镑购得——尽管当时房内既无浴室，楼上也无自来水，更没有电力供应。

sentences.en: When he came here, he'd been married for ten years.
sentences.zh: 他搬来此处时，已结婚十年。

sentences.en: During that time, he'd become one of the most famous writers in the English-speaking world.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他已成为英语世界最著名的作家之一。

sentences.en: His professional success was enormous, but his personal life wasn't as successful.
sentences.zh: 他在职业上取得了巨大成功，但个人生活却并不如意。

sentences.en: He was no longer on speaking terms 212 with his brother and had been devastated by the death at the age of seven of his elder daughter, Josephine.
sentences.zh: 他与弟弟早已断绝往来，而七岁时长女约瑟芬的夭折更令他悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Moving to Rosewood allowed the family to start a new life.
sentences.zh: 迁居罗斯伍德使全家得以开启新生活。

sentences.en: George regarded Rosewood as a pure example of a traditional country house of this part of England and did some of his most successful writing here.
sentences.zh: 乔治视罗斯伍德为英格兰这一地区传统乡村住宅的纯粹典范，并在此创作出他一些最成功的作品。

sentences.en: The house and its grounds became the family haven and their escape to privacy and quiet.
sentences.zh: 这座宅邸及其庭院成为家庭的避风港，也是他们寻求私密与宁静的场所。

sentences.en: The walls, and the mullioned windows were built of the local sandstone, the tiles on the roofs and the bricks of the chimney stack were baked from local clay, and the wooden structures inside came from oak trees which grow around here.
sentences.zh: 墙体与窗棂由当地砂岩砌成，屋顶瓦片与烟囱砖块取材于本地黏土烧制，室内木结构则取自周边生长的橡树。

sentences.en: Now, please look at the map I've given you of the house and gardens.
sentences.zh: 现在，请看我发给大家的这栋房屋及花园的地图。

sentences.en: We're here at the Information Centre.
sentences.zh: 我们目前所在位置是信息中心。

sentences.en: Follow the path marked with the arrow and the first area you come to is the orchard on your left.
sentences.zh: 请沿着标有箭头的小径前行，首先抵达的是您左侧的果园。

sentences.en: As you go further down the path, there's the kitchen garden on the right and as you go round the first sharp corner you will find, to your left, an area where different types of pear tree have been planted as well as some lovely flowers, and this is known as Pear Alley - designed by George himself.
sentences.zh: 继续沿小径下行，右侧是厨房菜园；绕过第一个急转弯后，您左侧将看到一片种植了多种梨树并配有美丽花卉的区域，此地名为‘梨巷’，由乔治本人设计。

sentences.en: Next to this is the greenhouse where some exotic plants and fruits are grown.
sentences.zh: 梨巷旁是温室，里面栽种着一些异域植物与水果。

sentences.en: Follow the path round the second corner and on your right you will see the entrance to the Mulberry www.TopSage.com 7.9919 Garden with its 500-year-old tree.
sentences.zh: 沿小径绕过第二个拐角，您右侧可见桑树园入口，园中矗立着一棵已有500年树龄的桑树。

sentences.en: Past the Mulberry Garden, follow the path mortaressy/age.com reach the front of the house.
sentences.zh: 穿过桑树园后，继续沿小径前行即可抵达宅邸正门。

sentences.en: I suggest you spend a good hour wandering around building.
sentences.zh: 我建议您花整整一小时在建筑内随意漫步。

sentences.en: A guide takes visitor groups round every two hours.
sentences.zh: 每两小时便有一名导游带领游客团体参观。

sentences.en: If you would like to purchase any of George's books or other souvenirs, then leave the house by the side entrance, where you will find our shop, which is situated between the house and the garage which contains the magnificent old Rolls-Royce car which used to belong to George.
sentences.zh: 若您想购买乔治的书籍或其他纪念品，请从侧门离开宅邸——您将在那里找到我们的商店，它位于宅邸与车库之间；车库内陈列着乔治昔日拥有的那辆宏伟的老款劳斯莱斯汽车。

sentences.en: I expect by this time you may also be in need of a rest and some refreshment.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，您大概也需要稍作休息并补充些能量了。

sentences.en: Most visitors are, sO why don't you visit the tea room on the far side of the garage?
sentences.zh: 大多数游客都是如此，那么何不前往车库远端的茶室呢？

sentences.en: If you have time, there is a lovely walk down towards the River Dudwell.
sentences.zh: 若您还有时间，可沿小路下行至杜德韦尔河，那是一段极美的徒步路线。

sentences.en: For me, this is the best part of the estate.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这是庄园最精彩的部分。

sentences.en: This isn't on the map but it is all clearly signposted.
sentences.zh: 该路线未标注在地图上，但沿途均有清晰指示牌。

sentences.en: You cross the field which spreads along the banks of the river.
sentences.zh: 您需穿越一片沿河岸延展的田野。

sentences.en: In spring, this area is well worth a visit. is Spend a minute or two watching the water pass by underneath as you cross the footbridge, and then continue along the River Walk through the woodland.
sentences.zh: 春季时，此地尤为值得一游。请在步行桥上驻足一两分钟，静静观赏脚下流水潺潺；随后继续沿河畔林间小道前行。

sentences.en: On a hot summer's day the trees along this path provide welcome shade.
sentences.zh: 炎炎夏日里，这条小径两侧的树木为您带来惬意荫凉。

sentences.en: Eventually you come to the water mill which used to provide the electricity for the house - only about four hours every evening - in George's time.
sentences.zh: 最终您将抵达一座水车磨坊——乔治在世时，它曾为宅邸供电，但每天仅能供应约四小时。

sentences.en: And, finally, for those of you who would like to see stunning views of the surrounding countryside and who are a little bit more energetic, when you return from the mill take the first turning on your left and climb up to the viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 最后，若您希望饱览周边乡野的壮丽景色，且体力尚佳，那么从磨坊返回途中，请在第一个左转路口拐入，攀登上观景台。

sentences.en: You won't regret it.
sentences.zh: 您定不会后悔。

sentences.en: Enjoy your visit!
sentences.zh: 祝您参观愉快！
